name: Smelt On, Smelt Off
summary: Galvan the Ancient in Stranglethorn asks you to bring him Mithril Bars and Iron Bars. The request calls for forty of each.

sections.title: Bars for Galvan
sections.body: Galvan the Ancient is waiting in Stranglethorn. You are to bring him forty Mithril Bars and forty Iron Bars, with both kinds of metal needed for his request.

faq.answer: Galvan the Ancient asks you for forty Mithril Bars and forty Iron Bars.

faq.q: Where do I bring the bars?
faq.answer: Bring the bars to Galvan the Ancient in Stranglethorn.

faq.q: How many Mithril Bars does Galvan need?
faq.answer: Galvan asks for forty Mithril Bars.

faq.q: How many Iron Bars does Galvan need?
faq.answer: Galvan asks for forty Iron Bars.

attribution: In-game quest text: Smelt On, Smelt Off
